articles.title: Town's CEO on the self-organizing company
articles.author: Casey Newton

zh.thesis: AI 代理将重塑公司组织方式，但取代人工尚需多年，且隐私与信任是最大障碍。
paragraphs: Town CEO 认为 AI 代理将取代传统软件，但当前仅能消除知识工作者 10-20% 的琐事，主要因为大多数人不了解 AI 能力，且习惯改变缓慢，如同 iPhone 普及耗时十年。
Town 通过构建个人档案和 wiki 提供个性化服务，成本约 100 美元/用户，但能快速赢得用户信任。公司计划推出团队版 wiki，自动整合员工信息，但隐私风险高，比如可能泄露薪资。
Greze 预测五年后 AI 将能执行隐私政策，小型高信任公司会先采纳，而大型企业因风险规避而滞后。他将 AI 视为生命体，但拒绝独立经济行为，强调人类控制，并禁止雇主查看员工对话。

en.thesis: AI agents will reshape how companies organize, but replacing human workers will take years, with privacy and trust as the biggest hurdles.
paragraphs: The CEO of Town argues that AI agents will eventually replace traditional software, but for now they can only eliminate 10-20% of the mundane tasks faced by knowledge workers. This is largely because most people are unaware of AI's capabilities and because habits change slowly—just as it took a decade for the iPhone to become ubiquitous.

Town builds personalized services by creating individual profiles and wikis, costing around $100 per user, yet it quickly earns user trust. The company plans to launch a team version of its wiki that automatically integrates employee information, but this carries high privacy risks, such as potentially leaking salaries.

Greze predicts that within five years AI will be able to enforce privacy policies, with small, high-trust companies adopting it first, while large enterprises lag due to risk aversion. He views AI as a living entity but rejects granting it independent economic agency, emphasizing human control and prohibiting employers from viewing employee conversations.

articles.title: 3 myths about coding with AI that even experienced developers still believe
articles.author: Abhinav Raj

zh.thesis: AI辅助编程的三大迷思——提升效率、可靠代码审查、只是自动补全——在实证面前都站不住脚。
paragraphs: 奥克兰大学追踪研究发现，82%的工程师写码时间减少，但工作转向验证和纠错，认知负荷加重，体验变差者从14%升至27%。
多伦多都会大学测试GitHub Copilot的代码审查，它常漏掉SQL注入等关键漏洞，却执着于风格和拼写，手动审计仍不可缺。
但Claude Opus 4.6在无源码情况下重写1.6万行Go工具，通过2001项测试，证明智能体远超自动补全，能自主推理迭代。

en.thesis: Three myths about AI-assisted programming—boosting efficiency, reliable code review, and being just autocomplete—collapse under empirical evidence.
paragraphs: A tracking study from the University of Auckland found that while 82% of engineers spent less time writing code, their work shifted to verification and error correction, increasing cognitive load and pushing the share of those reporting a worse experience from 14% to 27%.

Tests at Toronto Metropolitan University with GitHub Copilot's code review showed it often missed critical vulnerabilities like SQL injection, yet fixated on style and spelling, proving manual auditing remains indispensable.

However, Claude Opus 4.6 rewrote a 16,000-line Go tool without access to source code and passed 2,001 tests, demonstrating that agents go far beyond autocomplete, capable of autonomous reasoning and iteration.

articles.title: The Quest For Caffeine You Can Have At Night
articles.author: Scott Alexander

zh.thesis: 夜间喝咖啡又安然入睡的追求，催生了三种替代物，其中paraxanthine最安全有效。
paragraphs: 咖啡因半衰期长达十小时，阻碍夜间睡眠。三种应对思路：增强代谢酶CYP1A2（rutaecarpine）、直接服用代谢产物paraxanthine、或使用短效类似物methylliberine。
rutaecarpine虽能三小时内将酶提升三倍，但可能伤肝，且效果持续两天扰乱后续咖啡代谢。paraxanthine是咖啡因必然代谢产物，安全性高，半衰期短，但约三分之一使用者无效。
methylliberine半衰期仅1.5小时，但效果不稳定且抑制CYP1A2，与药物交互风险大。综合权衡，paraxanthine安全性最高，推荐作为夜间咖啡替代，预期作用时间为咖啡因的一半。

en.thesis: The desire to drink coffee at night and still sleep has spawned three alternatives, of which paraxanthine is the safest and most effective.
paragraphs: Caffeine's half-life of ten hours interferes with nighttime sleep, prompting three approaches: boosting the metabolic enzyme CYP1A2 (with rutaecarpine), taking the metabolite paraxanthine directly, or using a short-acting analog called methylliberine.

Rutaecarpine can triple the enzyme within three hours but may harm the liver, and its effect lasts two days, disrupting later caffeine metabolism. Paraxanthine is an inevitable metabolite of caffeine, is highly safe, has a short half-life, but fails for about a third of users.

Methylliberine has a half-life of only 1.5 hours, but its effects are inconsistent and it inhibits CYP1A2, raising drug-interaction risks. Weighing everything, paraxanthine is the safest option and is recommended as a substitute for nighttime coffee, with an expected duration of action half that of caffeine.

articles.title: Medicare for All should be more like Medicare
articles.author: Matthew Yglesias

zh.thesis: 「全民医保」应更贴近现有联邦医保计划的设计，而非照搬加拿大模式。
paragraphs: 「医保全民化」口号的吸引力，在于利用了现有「医疗保险」的普及和声望，以及公众普遍认同医疗不应由市场决定。但原则之下，实际政策设计仍待细化。
该口号的具体方案更接近加拿大模式，但作者主张应基于美国现有老年医保计划来构建，因其更符合美国实际和公众认知。

en.thesis: Medicare for All should be modeled on the existing Medicare program, not on the Canadian system.
paragraphs: The appeal of the slogan 'Medicare for All' lies in its use of the widespread popularity and reputation of the current Medicare program, along with the general public's belief that health care should not be left to the whims of the market. But beneath the principle, the actual policy design still requires careful consideration.

The specific plan behind the slogan is closer to the Canadian model, but the author argues that it should be built on the foundation of the existing U.S. Medicare program for the elderly, because that would be more in line with American realities and public perceptions.

articles.title: 科技爱好者周刊（第 408 期）：你需要知道的 AI 缓存知识

zh.thesis: 输入缓存命中价格远低于未命中，善用缓存可大幅降低大模型使用成本。
paragraphs: 大模型按 Token 计费，输入 Token 因需计算注意力而收费。多轮对话中，每次重复的前缀可缓存，避免重复计算，故缓存命中价可低至未命中的五十分之一，如 DeepSeek 仅收2分钱。
但缓存有有效期，各家不一，如 DeepSeek 10分钟、Anthropic 5分钟。为保持有效，AI Agent 常每30秒发送激活请求，但频次过高，最新建议改为每4分钟一次，以节省费用。

en.thesis: Input cache hits cost far less than misses, and using caching wisely can greatly reduce the cost of using large language models.
paragraphs: Large models charge by token, and input tokens incur costs because they require computation for attention. In multi-turn conversations, repeated prefixes can be cached to avoid recomputation, so cache hit prices can be as low as one-fiftieth of miss prices—for example, DeepSeek charges only 0.02 yuan.

However, caches have expiration times, which vary by provider: DeepSeek lasts 10 minutes, Anthropic 5 minutes. To keep the cache valid, AI agents often send keep-alive requests every 30 seconds, but that frequency is too high. The latest recommendation is to change it to once every 4 minutes to save costs.

articles.title: The Foothills Of Bay Area House Party
articles.author: Scott Alexander

zh.thesis: 湾区派对上的荒诞对话揭示了科技文化中的伦理麻木与自我欺骗，但讽刺的力度被冗长稀释。
paragraphs: 派对开篇即以「禁止基准答案钥匙」的标牌切入，暗指AI伦理的崩塌。随后Epstart创始人公开招募爱泼斯坦档案中的人，辩称湾区无孩所以是“减害”，讽刺科技界的道德虚无。
接着是AI色情创业者的诡辩：用“伦理深度伪造”规避意识问题，或用“预生成虚拟明星”规避非自愿内容，结果却与直接伪造无异。还有“饱和功利主义”、“AI腔调社交”等梗，每个都点到即止，缺乏深入剖析。

en.thesis: Absurd conversations at a Bay Area party expose tech culture's ethical numbness and self-deception, but the satire's punch is diluted by its length.
paragraphs: The party opens with a sign banning 'benchmark answer keys,' a jab at the collapse of AI ethics. Then an Epstart founder publicly recruits people from the Epstein files, arguing that since the Bay Area has no kids, it's 'harm reduction' — a biting satire of tech's moral vacuum.

Next comes the sophistry of an AI-porn entrepreneur: using 'ethical deepfakes' to dodge consent issues, or 'pre-generated virtual celebrities' to avoid non-consensual content, yet the result is no different from outright forgery. There are also gags like 'saturated utilitarianism' and 'AI-tone socializing,' each touched on briefly but not deeply dissected.

zh.thesis: 《独自打保龄》的过时预言已被证实，但其因果链和解决方案仍显薄弱。
paragraphs: 作者重读此书，惊讶于保龄球比喻只占少数篇幅，而当年争议性的预测——如教堂衰落、互联网无法替代线下社交——如今已然应验。
但共同主持人指出，该书将组织参与与美好结果相连的因果链含糊不清，且其论述属于对个人主义的反弹，或有害。
双方同意，电视造成约一半社会资本下降，而书中对此着墨甚少且未提出对策，此点对当今流媒体时代尤有共鸣。

en.thesis: The outdated predictions of 'Bowling Alone' have been confirmed, but its causal chain and proposed solutions remain weak.
paragraphs: Upon rereading the book, the author is struck by how little space the bowling metaphor actually occupies, while the once-controversial predictions—such as the decline of churches and the inability of the internet to replace face-to-face socializing—have since come true.
Yet the co-host points out that the book's causal chain linking organizational participation to positive outcomes is muddled, and its argument may be a harmful reaction against individualism.

Both agree that television accounts for roughly half of the decline in social capital, yet the book gives it scant attention and offers no remedies—a point that resonates strongly in today's streaming era.

articles.title: My very interesting Conversation with Daron Acemoglu
articles.author: Tyler Cowen

zh.thesis: 左翼自由主义因自身建制权力滥用而衰落，需重拾有意义的自由与共同体协商。
paragraphs: Acemoglu新书批评左翼自由主义，认为其近八十年掌权未善用建制力量，致内部脆弱，难敌外部攻击，如罗马衰亡。
他反对纯粹客观标准，主张以个体有意义自由为基，结合社会共识。但承认价值冲突（如非支配与不干预）时无完美解法，仅靠个体自由不够，需社区保护。
对话还触及教育、AI、生育率等，强调自动化不会自动带来繁荣，需亲劳工政策。Acemoglu对民主的反思指向自由至上与干预的平衡。

en.thesis: Left-liberalism's decline stems from its own abuse of institutional power, and it needs to reclaim meaningful freedom and communal deliberation.
paragraphs: Acemoglu's new book criticizes left-liberalism, arguing that its nearly eight decades in power have failed to make good use of institutional strength, leaving it internally fragile and vulnerable to external attacks, much like the fall of Rome.

He rejects purely objective criteria, advocating instead for meaningful individual freedom as a foundation, combined with social consensus. Yet he acknowledges that when values conflict—such as non-domination versus non-interference—there is no perfect solution, and individual freedom alone is insufficient; communities need protection.

The conversation also touches on education, AI, and fertility rates, emphasizing that automation does not automatically bring prosperity and requires pro-labor policies. Acemoglu's reflections on democracy point toward a balance between libertarianism and intervention.

articles.title: Google recommends these 7 NotebookLM prompts, and they showed me what I was missing
articles.author: Mahnoor Faisal

zh.thesis: Google 推荐的七个 NotebookLM 提示词展示了该工具正从「忠于来源的问答」转向「主动执行任务的代理」，尽管学生功能令人失望，但商业模式已见雏形。
paragraphs: 作者长期使用 NotebookLM，但近期更新让她失望。然而 Google 官方推荐的提示词让她理解了新方向：工具不再局限于总结上传的资料，而是能执行计算、联网搜索并生成成品，如将收据转为费用表。
七个提示词分三类：学生用（生成难度递增的测验、PDF 学习指南、从课程大纲批量添加链接）、商业用（计算营收增长并绘图、对比竞品调整营销信息）、个人用（分析装修收据、房产投资建模）。
关键转变是 NotebookLM 获得云端执行代码能力，可自行处理数据、生成图表，并能结合用户文档与网页信息做推荐。这使工具从「信息整理器」升级为「任务执行者」，但作者对部分方向仍持保留态度。

en.thesis: Google's seven recommended NotebookLM prompts reveal the tool's shift from a source-faithful Q&A assistant to an active, task-executing agent, and while the student features disappoint, a business model is beginning to take shape.
paragraphs: The author, a long-time NotebookLM user, was recently disappointed by updates to the tool. However, the official prompt suggestions from Google helped her understand its new direction: the tool is no longer limited to summarizing uploaded materials but can now perform calculations, search the web, and produce finished outputs, such as turning receipts into expense tables.

The seven prompts fall into three categories: student-focused (generating quizzes of increasing difficulty, creating PDF study guides, and batch-adding links from a course syllabus), business-focused (calculating revenue growth and plotting it, and comparing competitors to adjust marketing messaging), and personal use (analyzing renovation receipts and modeling real estate investments).

The key shift is NotebookLM's ability to execute code in the cloud, enabling it to process data, generate charts, and combine user documents with web information for recommendations. This upgrades the tool from an 'information organizer' to a 'task executor,' but the author remains skeptical about some of the directions taken.
